title: Apple fans are betting the booming 'services' business will take the sting out of an iPhone slowdown - here's why they might get a painful surprise (AAPL)
text: Apple fans are betting the booming 'services' business will take the sting out of an iPhone slowdown — here's why they might get a painful surprise (AAPL) By Troy Wolverton Nov 30, 2018, 6:02 pm 17 pts Apple's stock has fallen sharply since the beginning of the month due to concerns over weak iPhone sales. The company and its fans insist the "services" will provide the next leg of growth. But Jeffrey Kvaal, an analyst at Nomura, cast doubt on that argument in a new research note. Apple's services…
